data.one_liner: A type-safe and composable data validation library for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Acanthis provides validation for Dart built-in types and allows you to create custom validators. It supports schema composition, asynchronous validation checks, and JSON Schema/OpenAPI 3.1 exports.
use_when: You need to validate complex data structures or form inputs in Dart and Flutter.
You want composable, type-safe schema validation inspired by Zod.
avoid_when: You are looking for an all-in-one UI form builder widget.
You require code-generation based validation models (not documented).
strengths: Can export schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 and OpenAPI 3.1
weaknesses: Relatively new package with frequent breaking changes in recent versions
data.setup_notes: No special native configuration or code generation steps documented.

alternatives.name: formz
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a lightweight form validation library focused on individual form inputs and states.
